assertions.subject: Congenital megakaryocytic thrombocytopenia (CAMT)
assertions.quote: CAMT typically manifests as isolated, severe, and symptomatic thrombocytopenia from birth

assertions.subject: Congenital megakaryocytic thrombocytopenia (CAMT)
assertions.quote: this condition almost always progresses into bone marrow aplasia during childhood

assertions.subject: MYH9-RD
assertions.quote: This diagnosis is supported by the finding of Döhle-like structures in the neutrophil cytoplasm

assertions.subject: DIAPH1-related thrombocytopenia
assertions.quote: Monoallelic mutations in DIAPH1, a gene implicated in proplatelet expansion and cytoskeleton assembly, cause abnormally big platelets

assertions.subject: Radio-ulnar synostosis with amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia disease
assertions.predicate: congenital bilateral or unilateral proximal synostosis of the radius and ulna
assertions.quote: radio-ulnar synostosis with amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia disease is typified by congenital bilateral or unilateral proximal synostosis of the radius and ulna

assertions.subject: SRC-related thrombocytopenia
assertions.quote: Platelets in SRC-related thrombocytopenia are dysmorphic, exhibit a wide range of sizes, and have few granules

assertions.subject: Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome
assertions.quote: Severe immunodeficiency that results in premature mortality

assertions.subject: Paris-Trousseau thrombocytopenia, Jacobsen syndrome
assertions.quote: Anomalies of the cardiovascular system, central nervous system, gastrointestinal tract, kidney, and/or urinary tract

assertions.subject: GATA1-related diseases
assertions.quote: Hemolytic anemia with splenomegaly, dyserythropoietic anemia, and laboratory abnormalities similar to β-thalassemia

assertions.subject: Thrombocytopenia-absent radius syndrome
assertions.quote: Further anomalies in the upper and lower limbs, as well as bilateral radial aplasia

assertions.subject: Stormorken syndrome
assertions.quote: Tubular aggregation myopathy, congenital miosis, headache, mild anemia, facial dysmorphisms, anatomical or functional asplenia, ichthyosis, physical growth abnormalities, and cognitive impairment

assertions.subject: York platelet syndrome
assertions.quote: Myopathy, anomalies in the ultrastructure of platelets, including enormous electron-dense and target-like entities, increased vacuoles, and a moderate decrease in granules
